Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
Hi all, I have a question on Wake with Evening's Freshness versus
Form of Mist. If a vampire Wakes and blocks, and in that combat, the
acting vampire plays superior Form (continue action at +1 stealth),
is the Waking vampire allowed to still attempt to block or play reaction
cards, since it is 'the same' action?

Thanks,
Josh

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <5827s7$c...@newsstand.cit.cornell.edu>,


Yes, for exactly that reason. The woken vampire retains any intercept
he has, as well (until the end of the action).
